title: Member
description: A person registered to borrow tools. A member's loans are held by the Loan (TL-LEND-A3) aggregate; the member rules below count them.

title: Tool
description: One physical item in the catalog. Its condition decides whether it can be lent.
identity: Tool ID (two drills of the same model are two tools)

title: Loan
description: One member holding one tool, from borrowing to return.
